q: Why didn’t the load go through so my players aren’t on the bench oh my god. What can I do to remedy this today. Derik queen plays. There’s others who play. I need to add and drop in this situation
short: The 2:00 PM lineup save was rejected by ESPN because Jaylen Brown's and Ivica Zubac's games had already started, so nothing was saved. Brown and Zubac are locked on your bench for today, but you can still move Rollins and Peterson into the lineup and swap Collins for Mitchell Robinson.
answer:
Why it failed: the 2:00 PM CT lineup save moved 8 players in one batch and ESPN rejected the whole thing with the error that Jaylen Brown's and Ivica Zubac's games have started, so they can't move. When ESPN rejects a batch, none of it applies, so your lineup is exactly as it was. Brown (38.6 proj) and Zubac (35.5 proj) both had games today and were sitting on the bench. Their games have already started, so they are locked there for today. That points were lost is unfortunate, but it can't be undone.

What can still be fixed: Ryan Rollins (MIL, 23.3 proj for today) and Darryn Peterson (UTAH, 31.6 proj) are on your bench with games today, and the dashboard shows them as not locked. Your four UTIL spots are held by Randle, Ausar Thompson, Wiggins and Collins, and none of them has a game today. Move Rollins and Peterson into UTIL in place of Wiggins and Collins. Make just those moves by hand in ESPN, without touching Brown or Zubac, so the save isn't rejected again. Be aware that I could not confirm tip-off times for Utah. If Peterson's game has already started, he will be locked too and the swap will fail for him.

Add/drop: your roster has 17 players, 2 of them on IR (Edwards and Morant), so 15 active spots, and that is completely full. Any add needs a drop. The best add with a game today is Mitchell Robinson (BOS, free agent, 30.3 proj, instant add). Boston is listed in a later game tonight, so he should still be able to move into your lineup. Drop John Collins (31.8 proj but no game today). Put Robinson in your C slot in place of Jarrett Allen, who has no game today. One risk: on Nov 5 a Robinson add was rejected by ESPN with the error 'Too many players with default position C (maximum 4)'. If that happens again, you have to drop a default-C player instead, such as Jarrett Allen or Zubac.

Derik Queen: he is a free agent (30.5 proj, PF/C eligible), so he adds instantly. But the dashboard data shows New Orleans with no game today for him. One secondary schedule listing shows Pelicans at Kings at 10 PM ET, so I am not sure. Check the NBA schedule before spending a drop on him. If he does play tonight, he can replace Robinson in the same plan. Other free agents with a game today are Keegan Murray (29.3), Quentin Grimes (28.1) and Mitchell Robinson (30.3). Waiver players do not help today, because claims take 24 hours and start Monday.

How sure I am: your lineup log and roster are firm. Game times came from a weak secondary source and the dashboard data, so treat them as unconfirmed. Check the game status in ESPN before you drop anyone.

moves.do: Move Ryan Rollins and Darryn Peterson from the bench into UTIL, and move Andrew Wiggins and John Collins to the bench (do not touch Brown or Zubac)
moves.why: Rollins (23.3) and Peterson (31.6) have games today while Wiggins and Collins do not, worth about 55 projected points.
